key_insight: Staged closure learning trades some accuracy for substantially fewer model evaluations and more robust optimization than embedded training.
engineering_relevance: Learning unresolved dynamics offline can reduce training costs for simulation-based engineering workflows.
method: Compare embedded closure training with a two-stage data-assimilated approach.
Infer state and closure trajectories from observations, then train a closure model offline.
Evaluate both approaches on a synthetic SIQR epidemiological model with nonlinear, state-dependent quarantine.
evidence_signal: In the synthetic SIQR study, embedded training achieved the best average accuracy, while staged training preserved comparable qualitative behavior with moderately higher error and substantially fewer model evaluations.
watch_item: The findings come from one synthetic exemplar; accuracy and efficiency gains may depend on the system and assimilated trajectory quality.
paper_title: Efficient Closure Learning in Dynamical Systems: A Comparison of Data-Assimilated and Embedded Approaches
